about_the_game:
Dylio's Adventures is a Casual game of the Rogue Runner genre with “Toy” aesthetics, in which we control a peculiar Armadillo named Dylio who must overcome countless obstacles along interdimensional paths, to recover what a Crow has snatched from him, and thus be able to return home without perishing in the attempt.

Go through strange portals that change Dylio's shape, obtaining new abilities that allow you to avoid obstacles and activate intricate mechanisms to be able to overcome the different levels and explore new worlds, or try to beat your record in the endless mode.
